chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Sa'dan ibn Muslim from Abu Baseer from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) regarding bidding farewell to the month of Ramadan.

O Allah, You said in Your Revealed Book: 'The month of Ramadan is that in which the Quran was revealed.' And this is the month of Ramadan, and it has passed. So I ask You by Your Noble Face and Your Complete Words.

If there remains upon me a sin that You have not forgiven me, or You intend to punish me for it, or measure it out to me, let the dawn of this night rise, or this month end, only after You have forgiven it for me. O Most Merciful of the merciful ones.

O Allah, to You is the praise with all its praises, its beginning and its end, whatever You said of Yourself from it, and what the praising creatures said, the diligent, the counted, the reverent, who mention You and give thanks to You.

Those whom You supported in fulfilling Your right, from the varieties of Your creation, from the Proximate Angels, the Prophets, and the Messengers, and the varieties of speakers and glorifiers of You from all the worlds.
Because You brought us to the month of Ramadan, and upon us from Your bounties, and with us from Your portion and favor, and the manifesting of Your grace.
Therefore, to You belongs the ultimate praise, the eternal, the perpetual, the constant, the continuous, which does not cease throughout eternity. Majestic is Your praise.
You supported us in it until we fulfilled its fasting and its standing in prayer, and whatever was from us in it of righteousness, or gratitude, or remembrance.
O Allah, so accept it from us with the best of Your acceptance, and Your overlooking, and Your excusing, and Your pardoning, and Your forgiveness, and the reality of Your pleasure.
Until You make us successful in it with every sought good and generous bestowed gift, and protect us in it from every feared thing, or brought affliction, or earned sin.
O Allah, I ask You by the greatness of what anyone from Your creation asked You of, from the noble of Your Names, and the beautiful of Your praise, and the specific of Your supplication.
That You send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and that You make this month of ours the greatest month of Ramadan that has passed us since You sent us down to the world.

A blessing in the protection of my religion, and the salvation of my soul, and the fulfillment of my needs, and intercede for me in my requests, and complete the bounty upon me, and turn away evil from me, and clothe me with well-being in it.

And that You make me, by Your mercy, from those for whom You chose the Night of Predestination, and made it better than a thousand months, in the greatest reward, and the noblest treasures, and the goodness of gratitude, and long life, and enduring ease.
O Allah, and I ask You by Your mercy, and Your extensiveness, and Your excusing, and Your bounties, and Your majesty, and Your prior favor, and Your generosity.
That You do not make it the last promise from us to the month of Ramadan, until You bring it to us next year in the best of states.
And make me recognize its crescent with those who look at it and acknowledge it, in the best of Your health and well-being.
And bestow Your bounties, and extend Your mercy, and give generously of Your portion. O my Lord, the One besides Whom there is no lord for me.
Let this farewell from me to it not be a farewell of perishing, nor the last promise from me of meeting, until You show it to me next year in the broadest of bounties and the best of hopes.
And I am to You upon the best of loyalty. You are the Hearer of the supplication.
O Allah, hear my supplication, and have mercy on my humility and submissiveness to You, and my submission and reliance upon You.
And I am a submitter to You, not hoping for success, nor health, nor nobility, nor reaching (to anything) except with You and from You.
So favor upon me, Majestic is Your praise, and Holy are Your names, by delivering to me the month of Ramadan, and I am in well-being from every disliked thing and feared obstacle.
And from all the calamities. Praise is for Allah, Who supported us upon the fasting of this month and its standing, until He brought me to its last night.

ai.seo_question: What is the supplication for bidding farewell to Ramadan in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this supplication serves as a comprehensive ritual for bidding farewell to Ramadan, deeply rooted in Shia devotional practice to ensure the acceptance of the month's worship. It uniquely integrates the concept of Laylat al-Qadr, asking that the current year's Ramadan be elevated in status and that the supplicant be counted among those chosen for the Night of Decree. The text reflects the Shia emphasis on continuous spiritual renewal, seeking not just forgiveness but also the grace to witness the month again in a state of health and faith.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Is’haq, from Sa’adan Bin Muslim, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding bidding farewell to a Month of Ramazan,

‘O Allahazwj! Youazwj Said in Yourazwj Revealed Book [2:185] The Month of Ramazan is that in which the Quran was Revealed. And this is a Month of Ramazan, and it has come to an end. So I hereby ask Youazwj by Yourazwj Benevolent Face and Yourazwj Complete Word

, if there were any sins remaining upon me which You<sup>azwj</sup> have not Forgiven for me, or You<sup>azwj</sup> Intend to Punish me upon, or Measured out to me with, do not Cause the dawn of this night to emerge, or this Month to end except that You<sup>azwj</sup> have Forgiven me, O Most Merciful of the merciful ones.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! For You<sup>azwj</sup> is the Praise with all its Praises, its beginning and its end, whatever You<sup>azwj</sup> have Said for Yourself<sup>azwj</sup> from it, and what the creatures said, the Praisers, the strivers, the diligent, the counted ones, the repeaters of Your<sup>azwj</sup> Mention, and the ones grateful to You<sup>azwj</sup>

, those whom You<sup>azwj</sup> have supported upon the fulfilment of Your<sup>azwj</sup> right, from the varieties of Your<sup>azwj</sup> creatures, from the Angels of Proximity, and the Prophets<sup>as</sup>, and the Mursil Prophets<sup>as</sup>, and the varieties of the speakers, and Glorifiers to You<sup>azwj</sup> from the entirety of the worlds

, upon that You<sup>azwj</sup> Delivered to us a Month of Ramazan, and upon us from Your<sup>azwj</sup> Bounties, and with us from Your<sup>azwj</sup> Apportionment, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Favour, and expressing gratefulness to You<sup>azwj</sup>.

So, due to that, to You<sup>azwj</sup> end the Praise, the eternal, the perpetual, the constant, the continuous, the length of which does not get interrupted ever. Majestic is Your<sup>azwj</sup> Praise.
You<sup>azwj</sup> Supported us until we fulfilled its Fasts, and its standings from Prayers, and whatever was from us therein, from righteousness, or gratefulness, or remembrance.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Accept from us with goodness of Your<sup>azwj</sup> Acceptance, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Overlooking, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Excusing, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Pardoning, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Forgiveness, and reality of Your<sup>azwj</sup> Pleasure
, until we become successful in it with every goodness sought, with the Grants of beloved gifts, and Save us therein from every phobia, or affliction, or sin earned.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I ask You<sup>azwj</sup> with the greatness of what no one from Your<sup>azwj</sup> creatures asked with, from the Benevolence of Your<sup>azwj</sup> Name, and the Beauty of Your<sup>azwj</sup> Praise, and in particular I supplicate to You<sup>azwj</sup>

that You<sup>azwj</sup> Send Blessings upon Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and the Progeny<sup>asws</sup> of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>, and You<sup>azwj</sup> Make this Month of ours to be the greatest Month of Ramazan ever to have passed by us since You<sup>azwj</sup> Caused us to descend into the world.

Bless the innocence (artlessness) of my Religion, and sincerity of myself, and Fulfil my needs, and Heal me in my problems, and Complete the Bounties upon me, and Eliminate the evil from me, and Clothe the well-being for me therein.

And, Make me to be, by Your<sup>azwj</sup> Mercy, to be from the ones for whom the Night of Pre-destination Poured upon, and You<sup>azwj</sup> Made it to be better than a thousand months with regards to the magnification of the Recompense, and Benevolence of the hoarded treasures, and goodness of the gratefulness, and the prolonged life-span, and ease of the time.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I ask You<sup>azwj</sup> by Your<sup>azwj</sup> Mercy, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Extensiveness, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Excusing, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Endowments, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Majesty, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Favouring from before, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Generousness
, that You<sup>azwj</sup> do not Make it as being the last of the promises from us of a Month of Ramazan, until You<sup>azwj</sup> Deliver to us from the next one upon a good state
, and Make us recognise its new moon along with the viewers to it, and the acknowledgers of it in the well-being of health from You<sup>azwj</sup>.

And, Favour Your<sup>azwj</sup> Bounties, and Extend Your<sup>azwj</sup> Mercy, and the liberalness of Your<sup>azwj</sup> Apportionment. O my Lord<sup>azwj</sup>, the One besides Whom there is no lord for me apart from Him<sup>azwj</sup>!

This farewell from me should not happen to be a perishing farewell, nor the last promise from me of the meeting, until You<sup>azwj</sup> Show me the next one in extensiveness of the Bounties, and best of the hopes.
And (Make) me, in You<sup>azwj</sup> (presence) upon the best of the loyalties. You<sup>azwj</sup> are the Hearer of the supplications.
O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Hear my supplication, and have Mercy upon my supplication, and Humble me to You<sup>azwj</sup>, and Cause me to rely upon You<sup>azwj</sup>
, and I am a submitter to You<sup>azwj</sup>, not hoping for success, nor health, nor nobility, nor reaching (to anything) except with You<sup>azwj</sup> and from You<sup>azwj</sup>.

Therefore, Favour upon me, Majestic is Your<sup>azwj</sup> Praise, and Holy are Your<sup>azwj</sup> Names, by Delivering to me a Month of Ramazan, and I am in well-being from every abhorrence, and cautious from every obstacle.
The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Who Supported us upon the Fasts of this Month, and its standing (in Prayer), until the last night from it reached me’.
en.sarwar: 6. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Sa‘dan ibn Muslim from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that to say farewell to the month of Ramadan say this.

‘O Allah, You have said in Your book, “The month of Ramadan is that when the Holy Quran was revealed.” This month of Ramadan has ended. If there are still sins on me that You have not forgiven or want to punish me for or scale and measure me thereby, I appeal before Your honorable face, and through Your complete words, before the dawn of this night and ending of this month, to forgive me for such sins. You are the most Merciful of all merciful ones.

‘O Allah, all praise belongs to You because of all of Your exalted attributes, the first and the last of them. All praise belongs to You because of such attributes that You have mentioned about yourself and about which praising creatures, the assiduous ones who are counted (to be among your friends), have spoken. (They are) those who respect the deed of speaking of You and thanking You, those whom You helped to observe and fulfill Your rights of all of Your creatures of the angels close to You, the prophets, the messengers and all kinds of creatures speaking of Your glory, of the beings of the worlds. You deserve all praise for bringing the month of Ramadan to an end while we enjoy your bounties, the share of the sustenance (from You), your favors and all apparent generosity. For this reason You deserve the ultimate praise, forever, endlessly, constantly, eternally, through all times that never end throughout eternity. Majestic is your glory. You have helped us during this month until we completed its fasting, salat (prayer), and whatever good deeds we could do or thanks we could express or speak of You. O Allah, accept it from us in the best manner of Your acceptance, consideration, pardoning, overlooking, forgiveness, and the reality of Your pleasure so that You grant us success with all good things desired and with best gifts bestowed, and protect us against all frightening matters, attracted afflictions or committed sins.

‘O Allah, I appeal before You through the greatest matters by which any of Your creatures have appealed before You, of Your honorable names, glorious praise, special prayers, to grant salawat (favors and compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause). Please make this month of Ramadan the best month of Ramadan that has ever passed on us from the time You sent us to this world. Make it a blessing in matters of safety of my religion, salvation of my soul and the realization of my wishes. Accept its intercession for my wishes, in the completion of bounties upon me, the repelling of wickedness from me, and my achievement of the dress of good health in it. Make me one of those who experience the blessing of the night of destiny that You have made better than a thousand months, in matters of great reward and honorable treasures, good manners of thanksgiving, long life and continued ease and comfort.’

‘O Allah, I appeal before You through Your mercy, Your benevolence, Your pardoning, Your bounties, Your majesty, Your ever existing favors and generosity: do not make this the last month of Ramadan for us so that we may experience it in future in the best of conditions. Help us to recognize its new moon along with those who look for it and recognize its importance. Make it possible for me in good health, delightful bounties, the vast range of Your mercy, and the best of Your shares. O Lord, no one is my Lord besides You. I pray to You so this will not be my last farewell to it or the last occasion. Grant me the opportunity to experience it in the future, with a vast range of bounties and best hopes and to live before You with the best form of loyalty; You listen all prayers.

‘O Allah, listen to my prayers, be kind to me in my appeal, humble before You in my destitute condition, placing my trust in You while I am submitted before You. I do not have any hope for success, or good health, any honor, or the ability to reach anywhere without You and help from You. (O Allah), grant me the opportunity, Your praise is majestic and Your name is Holy, to experience the month of Ramadan in good health and safe from all difficulties, obstacles and all forms of misfortunes. All praise belongs to Allah for His helping us in fasting and worshipping up to the last of its nights during this month.”’
